raw_text: Suspected ULFA-I militants have sabotaged an Oil India Limited crude oil pipeline in Tinsukia district, Assam using improvised explosive devices. Two valve stations along the Duliajan-Numaligarh corridor were targeted. Major oil spill reported affecting approximately 12 hectares of wetland. Security forces deployed to the area. #Assam #ULFA #OilIndia #Pipeline
clean_text: ULFA-I militants sabotaged OIL pipeline in Tinsukia using IEDs at two valve stations. Major spill affecting 12 hectares of wetland. Security forces deployed.
